mentions.name: Deno TUI library
mentions.description: A terminal user interface (TUI) library for Deno, being built because the existing Deno TUI library is buggy and non-ergonomic. It is intended to power a dashboard for keeping tabs on the state of the different processes in the Wii balance board music control setup.
mentions.problem: The existing TUI library for Deno is kind of buggy and non-ergonomic, so the author is writing their own to build a monitoring dashboard.
mentions.source_excerpt: The bit of hair on this yak that I'm currently shaving is building a TUI library for Deno so that I can build a nice dashboard for keeping tabs on the state of all the different pieces.
